$comment: SHARED ORG CORE. Which DesignStack story becomes which reusable block, for EVERY BrowserStack product (all render from @browserstack/design-stack). Story IDs verified against a running Storybook (584 entries, design-stack 9.8.0) on 2026-08-05. Run `capture-storybook.mjs --core --dry-run` after any design-stack bump to catch IDs that no longer exist. Product-specific compositions are NOT here — they are captured per product into Tier 6 during SETUP.

blocks.comment: SIDEBAR. App chrome — present on every product screen. Mark the current section active. Never restyle. NB the --primary story captures as an empty shell (content is state-driven and does not survive a static capture), so this uses the brand-image story instead.
PAGE HEADER. Title on the left, actions right-aligned. Use for every product page.
DISMISSIBLE HELP BANNER. Sits above page content. Optional. NB the --primary story renders its post-dismissal confirmation by default, which is why this uses the scoped-dismiss story instead.
TABLE, CONDENSED. Dense rows — the default for list-heavy product screens. Prefer this over the roomier Primary table.
TABLE HEADER WITH SORTING. Use when a column is sorted. Shows the sort affordance in the header cell.
CHECKBOX COLUMN + SELECT-ALL HEADER CELL. Use for any bulk-action table.
TABLE LOADING STATE. Real skeleton rows. Use this instead of inventing a spinner.
TAG PILL. For click-to-filter behaviour keep the pill clickable — do not wrap it in a Tooltip, that swallows the click.
TAG PILL, DISMISSIBLE. Use for applied-filter chips.
STATUS BADGE. Use for run/test/session status. Icon variant reads faster in a dense table.
ROW ACTION MENU (meatball). Captured OPEN — the open menu is what never gets guessed right.
PAGINATION. Sits below the table.
SWITCH with label + description. Use for a single on/off setting or feature flag (e.g. 'Block all permissions'). The label/description pattern is what makes a flag legible to a non-technical user.
SETTINGS PANEL ROW with a switch on the right. Use to build a list of toggleable settings/flags in a config panel — the Advanced Config / Browser Flags pattern.
CHECKBOX with label. Use for multi-select options where more than one can be on at once.
RADIO GROUP with descriptions. Use for one-of-many choices where each option needs a line of explanation.
TEXT INPUT with label. The default single-line field.
SELECT / COMBOBOX. Use for a single choice from a longer list. Captured open so the option list markup is real.

INLINE ALERT with action buttons. Use for a warning that needs the user to do something — e.g. a permission conflict where the fix is one click ('Turn off Block all permissions'). This is the right component for an inline conflict warning; do NOT recolour a banner.
INLINE ALERT with a description paragraph. Use for a non-actionable notice or explanation.
EMPTY STATE. Use when a list/panel has no items yet.
CENTERED MODAL with a primary action. Use for a confirm/decision dialog — e.g. 'Turn off Block all permissions for this test?'. Captured with the modal open.
BUTTONS — every variant/size. Extract the primary (brand) and secondary (neutral) button markup from here; do not author button classes by hand.
